questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 40 days. He works at it for 10 days, and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 45 days. In how many days will A and B working together finish 75% of the same work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**** Given:**

A can complete the work in 40 days

A works for 10 days, so the remaining work is done by B in 45 days

**Calculation:**

A does (1/40)*10 = 1/4 or 25% of the work in 10 days

The remaining 75% of the work is done by B in 45 days, so B alone would take

(45/0.75) = 60 days to complete all the work

(A + B) = (1/40 + 1/60) = 1/24 job/day

So, to finish 75% of the work,

(A + B) = (0.75/1/24) = 18 days 

**∴ A and B together will complete 75% of the work in 18 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 40 days.

Works A at it for 10 days, and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 45 days.

**Calculation:**

Let B complete the same work in x days.

A + B = 1 

⇒ 10over40 + 45over x = 1

⇒ 45over x = 1 - 1over4 = 3over4

⇒ x = 4over3 × 45 = 60 days

Let A and B will take t days to finish 75% of the same work.

⇒ tover40 + tover60 = 75%

⇒ t (1over40 + 1over60) = 3over4

⇒ t × 10over240 = 3over4

⇒ t = 3over4 × 24over1 = 18 days.

**∴ A and B will take 18 days to finish 75% of the same work.**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 12 hours and 16 hours, respectively. Both pipes are opened together and after 3 hours pipe B is closed. How much time (in hours) will pipe A take to fill the remaining cistern?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 12 hours and 16 hours.

After 3 hours pipe B is closed.

**Calculation:**

Let pipe A take to fill the remaining cistern be x hr.

A + B = 1 (Total work)

⇒ x+3over12 + 3over16 = 1

⇒ x+3over12 = 1 - 3over16 = 13over16 

⇒ x + 3 = 13over16 × 16 = 39over4

⇒ x = 39over4 - 3 = 27over4 = 6(3)/(4)

**∴ Pipe A takes to fill the remaining cistern is 6(3)/(4) hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Part of the tank is filled by pipes A and B in 3 hours.

⇒ 3(1over12 + 1over16) = 3 × 7over48 = 7over16

Remaining part = 1 - 7over16 = 9over16

This part is filled by pipe A.

Required time = 9over16 × 12 = 27over4 = 6(3)/(4) 

∴ Pipe A takes to fill the remaining cistern is 6(3)/(4) hours.

questions.question: The average of 23 numbers is 45. The average of the first 12 numbers is 40.5 and the average of the last 6 numbers is 48.5. What is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 23 numbers is 45

Average of the first 12 numbers is 40.5

Average of the last 6 numbers is 48.5 

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of numbers/Total numbers

**Calculation:**

Average = Sum of numbers/Total numbers

⇒ 45 = Sum of 23 numbers/23

∴ Sum of 23 numbers = 45 × 23 = 1035

Again,

⇒ 40.5 = Sum of first 12 numbers/12

∴ Sum of first 12 numbers = 40.5 × 12 = 486

Again, 

48.5 = Sum of last 6 numbers/6

∴ Sum of last 6 numbers = 48.5 × 6 = 291

Now,

Sum of remaining 5 numbers = Sum of 23 numbers - (Sum of First 12 numbers + Sum of last 6 numbers)

Sum of remaining 5 numbers = 1035 - (486 + 291) = 1035 - 777 = 258

∴ Average of remaining 5 numbers = 258/5 = 51.6

**∴ The average of remaining 5 numbers is 51.**

questions.question: Let x be the greatest number of 4-digits which when divided by 12, 15, 16 and 20, the remainders are 9, 12, 13, and 17, respectively. The sum of the digits of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X be the greatest number of 4-digits which when divided by 12, 15, 16 and 20 and the remainders are 9, 12, 13, and 17, respectively

**Calculation:**

For LCM (12, 15, 16, 20)

⇒ 12 = 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 16 = 4 × 4

⇒ 20 = 2 × 2 × 5

LCM = 24 × 3 × 5 = 240

We know that the greatest 4-digit number is 9999

Now, we divide 9999 by 240 and after dividing the remainder is 159

∴ We subtract 159 in 9999

⇒ 9999 - 159 = 9840

Now, 12 - 9 = 3, 15 - 12 = 3, 16 - 13 = 3, 20 - 17 = 3

Here, the difference is the same which is 3S

So, the greatest number which is divisible by 12, 15, 16, and 20 is

⇒ 9840 - 3 = 9837

Sum of digits of 9837 = 9 + 8 + 3 + 7 = 27

**∴ The sum of the digits of x is 27**

questions.question: Two trains A and B are running in the same direction at the uniform speeds of 80 km/h and 100 km/h, respectively. Train A leaves the station 30 min earlier than the train B from the same station. The time taken by train B to cross train A will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Speed of train A = 80 km/h

Speed of train B = 100km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:-**

Let, the time taken to cross-train A is T hr.

According to the question, A leaves the station 30 min earlier 

Distance traveled by A in 30 min (i.e. (1)/(2) hr) = 80 × (1)/(2) = 40 km.

Distance traveled by A in T hr = 80T

Distance traveled by B in T hr = 100T 

Train B will cross train A if 

100 T = 80 T + 40

⇒ 20T = 40

⇒ T = 2 hours

So, **Train B will take 2 hours to pass train A.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

For train A -

Distance travel in first 1 hour = 40 + 80 = 120 km

Distance travel in next 1 hour = 120 + 80 = 200 km

Distance travel in next 1 hour = 200 + 80 = 280 km

For train B -

Distance travel in first 1 hour = 100km

Distance travel in next 1 hour = 100 + 100 = 200 km

So, **Train B passes the train A in 2 hours.**

questions.question: When the number 25 is included in a list of natural numbers, their average is increased by 4. When the number 7 is included in the new list, the average of the numbers in the new list is decreased by (1)/(3). How many numbers were there in the original list?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let there be n numbers in the original list and their mean be x.

Then, the sum of n numbers = n × y

And the Average of the number is A

According to question,

⇒ x / n = A ----------------(1)

⇒ x + 25 / n + 1 = A + 4 ------------(2)

⇒ x + 32 / n + 2 = (A + 4) - 1 / 3 ------------(3)

By solving the equation (1) and (2) we get,

⇒ x + 25 / n + 1 = A

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest and the simple interest accrued on an amount of ₹40,000 in 2 years was ₹324. The rate of interest per annum was:
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

CI - SI = 324

Principal = 40000, Time = 2 years

**Formula used:-**

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal

CI = P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ - 1]

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:-**

According to question-

⇒ P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ - 1] - (P × R × T)/100 = 324

⇒ 40000 [(1 + R/100)² - 1] - (40000 × R × 2)/100 = 324

⇒ 40000 [{(100 + R)²/100² - 1} - {R × 2}/100 = 324

⇒ 400 [{100² + R² + 2 × 100 × R -100²}/100 - 2R] = 324

⇒ [{R² + 200R}/100 - 2R] = 324/400

⇒ (R² + 200R - 200R)/100 = 324/400

⇒ R² = 32400/400

⇒ R² = 81 = 9%

∴** The rate of interest per annum is 9%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Formula used:-

Difference between CI - SI for 2 years, 

⇒ D = P(R/100)²

Where,

D = Difference, P = Principal, R = Rate of interest

**Calculation:-**

⇒ 324 = 40000(R/100)²

⇒ R² × 40000 = 3240000

⇒ R² = 81

⇒ R = 9%

∴ **Required rate of interest is 9%.**

questions.question: An article is sold at a profit of 25%. If its cost price is reduced by 20% and it is sold at the same selling price, then what will be the profit per cent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 25%, CP is reduced = 20%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (100 + P%)/100

Profit = SP - CP

Profit% = P × 100/CP

**Calculation:**

Let CP be Rs. 100

SP = 100 × (100 + 25)/100 = 125

If CP is reduced 20%, then CP = 80

But SP is the same i.e Rs. 125

Profit = 125 - 80 = 45

Profit% = 45 × 100/80 = ​56(1)/(4)​​%

**​∴ The profit % is 56(1)/(4)%**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to ₹9,648 in 4 years and to ₹11,484 in 7 years at the same rate percent per annum at simple interest. The sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount in 4 years = ₹9,648

Amount in 7 years = ₹11,484

**Formula used:**

A = P + SI

**Calculation:**

Amount in 4 years = ₹9,648

Amount in 7 years = ₹11,484

SI in 3 years = 11,484 - 9,648 = 1836

SI in 1 years = 1836/3 = 612

SI in 4 years = 612 × 4 = 2448

For 4 years, A = P + SI

⇒ 9,648 = P + 2448

⇒ P = 9648 - 2448 = 7200

**∴ The sum is Rs. 7200.**

questions.question: The cost price of 62 books is equal to the selling price of 50 books. The profit per cent is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of 62 books = SP of 50 books

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP - CP

Profit% = P × 100/CP

**Calculation:**

CP × 62 = SP × 50

⇒ (CP/SP) = 50/62 = 25/31

CP = 25, SP = 31

Profit = 31 - 25 = 6

Profit% = 6 × 100/25 = 24

**∴ The profit % is 24%.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marked his goods in at 25% higher price than their cost price. Finally, he sold the goods at 30% discount on the marked price. His profit/loss percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MP is 25% higher than CP

Discount = 30%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 - L%)/100

L% = L × 100/CP

**Calculation:**

Let CP be Rs. 100x

MP = 125x

SP = 125x × (100 - 30)/100 = 125x × 7/10

SP = 87.5x

Loss = 100x - 87.5x = 12.5x

Loss% = 12.5x × 100/100x = 12.5

**Hence, the required loss is 12.5%**

CP : MP = 70 : (100 - P) ------- (2)

⇒ 4 : 5 = 70 : (100 - P) -- From (1) and (2)

⇒ 4(100 - P) = 350

⇒ 4P = - 50

P = - 12.5

Profit is negative because there is a loss of 12.5%

⇒ [(124x/100) - 69] - (88x/100) = (88x/100) × (20/100)

⇒ .36x - 69 = 0.176

⇒ .36x - 0.176x = 69

⇒ 0.184x = 69

⇒ x = (69 × 1000)/184 = 375

**∴ The Cost price of the item is 375**

questions.question: What is the third proportional to 6 and 42?
questions.solution:

The third proportional to any two numbers a and b is given directly by the formula: b² ÷ a.

Here, a = 6 and b = 42.

Third proportional = (42 × 42) ÷ 6

Third proportional = 42 × 7 = 294

**∴ The correct answer is 294.**

First number (a) = 6

Second number (b) = 42

**Formula Used:**

If x is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b :: b : x.
